## Names

<a id="zoom_clamp_cursor"></a>
### [`zoom_clamp_cursor`](../../../../src/zoom/zoom_clamp.asm#L6) `$32FC`

*routine*

Keeps the cursor in the zoom limits: cursor_x at most $7e (when the pad is touched), cursor_y at most $af. X and Y are the cursor point.

- **Called from:** [`zoom_choose_area`](zoom_choose_area.md#zoom_choose_area) [`$2FA1`](../../../../src/zoom/zoom_choose_area.asm#L24), [`zoom_choose_area`](zoom_choose_area.md#zoom_choose_area) [`$309C`](../../../../src/zoom/zoom_choose_area.asm#L168)
- **Reads:** [`cursor_x`](../../memory-map.md#cursor_x), [`cursor_y`](../../memory-map.md#cursor_y)
- **Writes:** [`cursor_x`](../../memory-map.md#cursor_x), [`cursor_y`](../../memory-map.md#cursor_y)
